# GAN Bluetooth browser library

`gan-web-bluetooth-3.0.2.js` is the self-contained browser bundle from
https://esm.sh/gan-web-bluetooth@3.0.2/es2022/gan-web-bluetooth.bundle.mjs
for https://github.com/afedotov/gan-web-bluetooth (MIT).
It is served locally with no runtime CDN requests.

The upstream library implements GAN Gen2, Gen3 and Gen4 protocols, including
AES encryption and MAC-derived keys. Individual hardware/firmware support must
be confirmed with a physical cube.

Included dependency notices: RxJS (Apache-2.0), tslib (BSD-0-Clause), aes-js (MIT).
See the adjacent LICENSE files. The bundle also contains esm.sh's unenv browser
compatibility code (MIT, https://github.com/unjs/unenv).
